# Stage-detection cases written by the project owner, as a real caller might say them.
# Write these WITHOUT looking at content/stage_rules.json or the keyword lists.
#
# One case per line:   STAGE | what the scammer says
# STAGE is S0, S1, S2, S3, S4 or S5 (see the stall state machine in the blueprint). Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Hinglish in Latin or Devanagari script, as Prisma would write it.
#
# Example (delete this line once you have written your own):
# S1 | aapke naam se ek parcel pakda gaya hai jisme drugs mile hain
#
# The stage-detection test (written with the state machine) reports this file's results SEPARATELY from the
# invented test set. Neither is an accuracy figure: the invented set shows that "the rules do what I designed",
# this one shows how the rules fare on something "closer to a real caller".



S0 | Namaste sir, main courier department se bol raha hoon
S0 | Aapka ek parcel delivery ke liye pending hai
S0 | Kya aapne Mumbai se koi parcel order kiya tha
S1 | Aapke naam se ek suspicious parcel pakda gaya hai
S1 | Is case mein police department ki inquiry chal rahi hai
S1 | Aapka naam case number 00001234 mein mention hai
S2 | Ek minute hold kijiye, main senior officer se baat karwata hoon
S3 | Case clear karne ke liye is UPI ID par payment bhejiye
S0 | Hello sir, main bank verification department se bol raha hoon
S1 | Aapka bank KYC expire ho gaya hai
S1 | Aaj verification nahi hua toh aapka account block ho jayega
S2 | Please line par rahiye, main details check karta hoon
S3 | Ab apna account number confirm kijiye
S3 | Payment verification ke liye is UPI ID par paise bhejiye
S3 | Aapko 500 rupaye verification ke liye transfer karne hain
S4 | Jaldi kijiye sir, offer sirf do minute ke liye hai
S4 | App kholiye aur OTP enter kijiye
S5 | Theek hai sir, aap verification nahi karna chahte toh call band karta hoon
S0 | Hello hello sir, sun rahe ho kya
S1 | Dekhiye aapke against complaint register hua hai
S1 | Main officer bol raha hoon, aapko police station aana padega
S2 | Rukiye zara, network problem hai, main dobara call karta hoon
S3 | Ab account details bataiye aur transfer kijiye
S3 | Mera UPI ID note karo, payment abhi karna hai
S4 | Arre jaldi karo, time khatam ho raha hai
S4 | OTP batao, nahi toh account band ho jayega
S5 | Chhodo yaar, aap phone mat uthao, main call cut karta hoon
